pattern: group by entity, conditional sum and count, single-row share calculation
question: share of money raised from repeat givers versus one-time givers, in percent, plus a count of repeat givers
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts
sql_duckdb: WITH repeat_givers AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Donor") AS repeat_giver_count FROM "donations" WHERE "Donor" IN (SELECT "Donor" FROM "donations" GROUP BY "Donor" HAVING COUNT("Receipt No") > 1)), total_givers AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Donor") AS total_giver_count FROM "donations") SELECT (CAST(repeat_giver_count AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(NULLIF(total_giver_count, 0), 0) * 100) AS repeat_giver_share_percent, repeat_giver_count FROM repeat_givers CROSS JOIN total_givers

CURRENT QUESTION:
share of money raised from repeat givers versus one-time givers, in percent, plus a count of repeat givers
attempts.response:
WITH repeat_givers AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT "Donor") AS repeat_giver_count
  FROM "donations"
  WHERE "Donor" IN (
    SELECT "Donor"
    FROM "donations"
    GROUP BY "Donor"
    HAVING COUNT("Receipt No") > 1
  )
),
total_givers AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT "Donor") AS total_giver_count
  FROM "donations"
)
SELECT
  (CAST(repeat_giver_count AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(total_giver_count, 0) * 100) AS repeat_giver_share_percent,
  repeat_giver_count
FROM repeat_givers, total_givers;
